definitions.gloss: at-bat, plate appearance, turn at bat
definitions.explanation: A batter's turn to face the pitcher in baseball. Also refers to the batter's box area where the batter stands.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{今日|きょう}4{打席|だせき}3{安打|あんだ}だった。
examples.english: He went 3 for 4 (3 hits in 4 at-bats) today.

examples.japanese: {初|はつ}{打席|だせき}でホームランを{打|う}った。
examples.english: He hit a home run in his first at-bat.

examples.japanese: {打席|だせき}に{入|はい}る{前|まえ}に{素振|すぶ}りをした。
examples.english: He took some practice swings before stepping up to the plate.

notes:
RELATED BASEBALL STATISTICS:
・{打率|だりつ} (batting average)
・{打数|だすう} (at-bats, official at-bats excluding walks/hit-by-pitch)
・{安打|あんだ} (hit)
・{打点|だてん} (RBI, runs batted in)

NOTE ON {打席|だせき} vs {打数|だすう}:
・{打席|だせき} (plate appearance) - all turns at bat
・{打数|だすう} (at-bat) - excludes walks, sacrifices, hit-by-pitch
・{打率|だりつ} is calculated using {打数|だすう}, not {打席|だせき}

COLLOCATIONS:
・{打席|だせき}に{入|はい}る (to step up to the plate)
・{打席|だせき}に{立|た}つ (to stand at bat)
・{初|はつ}{打席|だせき} (first at-bat)
・{代打|だいだ}の{打席|だせき} (pinch-hitter's at-bat)
・{連続|れんぞく}{打席|だせき}{出塁|しゅつるい} (consecutive plate appearances reaching base)
